title: English Civil War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "English Civil War", at revision 1378642637, opens: "The English Civil War or Great Rebellion was a series of civil wars and political machinations between Royalists and Parliamentarians in the Kingdom of England from 1642 to 1651. Part of the wider 1639 to 1653 Wars of the Three Kingdoms, the struggle consisted of the First English Civil War and the Second English Civil War. The Anglo-Scottish war of 1650 to 1652 is sometimes referred to as the Third English Civil War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q80330, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of armed conflicts and political machinations between Parliamentarians and Royalists". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: The Wikidata import wrote this event's lane from its own point. The event names no place record, so the timeline has no other source for the lane.
